thread:
ashley_support: heads-up — AtlasPay reported sharp latency regressions since 09:03 UTC, p95 ~820ms, p99 ~1.5s on /v1/generate. They provided request_ids: r:8f3a2, r:8f3a7. Error rate is low but tail is horrible.

maria_ops: thanks — are we seeing this in prod only or staging too? any recent deploys?

ashley_support: looks prod-only. No deploys in the last 6 hours. Metric spike aligns with a traffic burst at 09:02. Logs show a lot of 200s but high tokenization/first-token latency.

vijay_runtime: i'm looking at runtime dashboards — prefix cache miss rate jumped from ~6% to ~54% at 09:02. KV cache eviction churn also increased. That will amplify first-token p95.

kevin_sre: can you paste the grafana panel query?

vijay_runtime: panel: sum(rate(kv_prefix_miss_total[1m])) by (instance) / sum(rate(kv_prefix_requests_total[1m])) by (instance) * 100
  shows a cluster-wide miss spike on node pool g4x-prod-2.

sam_engineer: seeing a pattern in logs: clients are sending session-scoped prefixes with ephemeral IDs (prefix=user-session-<uuid>). That defeats warmup and creates lots of tiny hot keys. Could be a client-side rollout at AtlasPay.

maria_ops: any evidence of a cache-key normalization bug? iirc we had a fix for trailing slashes earlier.

vijay_runtime: i ran a quick histogram of unique prefixes in last 5m — count went from ~3.2k to ~92k. That's not normalization; it's key cardinality explosion. However there is also a minor bug in normalization when headers include X-Client-Nonce causing duplicate prefix variants. i can open a quick PR.

kevin_sre: mitigation options we can do now? customer is ramping.

vijay_runtime: immediate mitigations: 1) enable prefix-grouping on the affected pool (groups similar prefixes under a normalized bucket) — low-risk toggle. 2) flip on short-lived warm-start job to pre-populate common model KV entries (we have job cache-warm-start) 3) increase eviction TTL from 30s -> 90s for g4x-prod-2 to reduce churn.

sam_engineer: + route AtlasPay traffic to fallback model_variant: small-quantized for 10m to lower token compute while we stabilize. -> reduces overall throughput pressure.

ashley_support: can you do 1 and 3 now? customer asked for an ETA. i told them 15-30m mitigation window.

vijay_runtime: i'm enabling prefix-grouping on g4x-prod-2 now. will post when done.

deploy-bot: prefix-grouping feature flag toggled on g4x-prod-2 by vijay_runtime at 09:18 UTC — rollout 100%.

vijay_runtime: increase eviction TTL set to 90s on that pool. starting warm-start job next.

maria_ops: what about root cause mitigation to prevent recurrence?

vijay_runtime: medium-term actions: 1) add server-side prefix normalization to strip session tokens / non-meaningful segments. 2) add cardinality alert when unique-prefix rate > 10x baseline for 5m. 3) implement staggered warm-start (splay per instance) to avoid synchronous prefill storms. 4) update docs + SDK example to recommend application-level stable prefixes.

kevin_sre: also suggest a circuit-breaker for prefix-miss rate: if miss_rate > 40% for 2m, divert a subset of traffic to deduped prefix path or fallback variant. reduces tail for customers.

sam_engineer: repro steps for devs: 1) reproduce burst by generating 50k requests with distinct session prefixes 2) watch kv_prefix_miss_total 3) tail logs for kv_fill_latency 4) run `curl -H \"X-Prefix: user-session-<random>\" ...` script we used earlier. I'll drop the script in the ticket.

ashley_support: customer update: told AtlasPay we mitigated and are investigating root cause; asked if they can provide recent SDK version — they are on 2.1.3.

vijay_runtime: quick note on the normalization bug — it appends nonce headers to prefix when header present. i'll ship a small hotfix to canonicalize headers and add a unit test. low risk.

deploy-bot: hotfix branch opened: runtime/prefix-normalize-hotfix by vijay_runtime (CI green).

maria_ops: ownership + timelines?

vijay_runtime: i'll handle hotfix and cardinality alert (today). sam will add repro script and run load test (in 30m). kevin will draft circuit-breaker proposal (EOD). maria, can you send the customer note once we confirm stabilization?

maria_ops: yep.

kevin_sre: monitoring — p95 for first-token dropped from 820ms -> 160ms after TTL increase + grouping. still watching p99 tail.

ashley_support: AtlasPay confirms latency much improved on their side. thanks team :thumbsup:

vijay_runtime: follow-ups: PR for normalization + unit tests, add cardinality alert, add staged warm-start job with 5s splay per instance, document prefix best-practices in SDK guide. assigning tickets now.

sam_engineer: dropping repro script in #tickets/4572 in 3m.

ashley_support: closing the support escalation for now, will reopen if customer sees relapse.

kevin_sre: recommend we run a chaos test where we simulate client-key entropy to verify warm-start resilience. scheduling for next Friday.

maria_ops: thanks all — great quick coordinated work.
